data.description: Experience an opulent lifestyle amid breathtaking outdoor spaces and world-class leisure facilities at DAMAC Hills, the epitome of luxury and nature.

data.answer:
The first community project of DAMAC Properties, DAMAC Hills Dubai, is a prime choice for those interested in investing in the city’s thriving real estate landscape. The residential units in clusters boast scenic views of the district and offer lifestyle amenities like swimming pools, jogging tracks, and gyms.

In collaboration with Fendi, the Trump Organization, and Paramount Hotels & Resorts, DAMAC Properties developed this family-friendly community in Dubai that features studio to 4-bedroom apartments, 3 to 6-bed villas, and townhouses with dedicated parking spaces and tons of amenities.

There are three popular communities in DAMAC Hills: Trump International Golf Club, Akoya Drive, and Akoya Park, with each consisting of a number of sub-communities. Home to the 18-hole Champion Standard Course and the 9-hole floodlit PAR 3 course, the Trump International Golf Club features exclusive villas offering breathtaking views. Other facilities in the golf club are an amphitheater, restaurants, gyms, pools, and a health club.

Drawing inspiration from Beverly Hills in Paris, Akoya Drive comprises high-end eateries, a cinema, an ice rink, hotels, and boutique stores. Meanwhile, Akoya Park has spacious villas with exquisite water features. It covers an area of 4 million square feet. 

Off-plan Projects in Damac Hills

Several projects are under construction in the neighborhood. The top off-plan projects in DAMAC Hills include Utopia at DAMAC Hills, a villa community expected to be completed in 2026, and Park Greens at DAMAC Hills 2. DAMAC Hills also houses a gated community called Gems Estates, which is expected to be completed by the end of 2025.

A La Carte Villas by DAMAC Properties is one of the newest residential ventures to be developed in the DAMAC Hills community. It will feature 3- and 4-bedroom units, with a maid's room and terrace option.

Meanwhile, the upcoming apartment projects in DAMAC Hills are Emaar Club Drive and Golf Gate 2. The project of Emaar Properties, Emaar Club Drive, will soon become a part of the in-demand luxury apartments in DAMAC Hills. Golf Gate 2 is also an under-construction apartment building featuring spacious 1- and 2-bedroom apartments.

Another highly awaited property is Cavalli Estates. Prospective residents have the option to select from 200 units at Cavalli Estates, comprising six-bedroom mansions spanning 11,317 sq. ft. and seven-bedroom mansions covering 17,531 sq. ft. 

Renting a Property in Damac Hills

DAMAC Hill offers various properties for rent in Dubai. You can get a studio apartment in DAMAC Hills for AED 35,000 per year and a 1-bedroom flat for AED 44,999. For a 2-BHK, a renter must pay a minimum of AED 115,000 and AED 210,000 for a 3-bedroom apartment.

Those looking for a villa can rent a 2-bedroom house at the starting price of AED 200,000, whereas a 3-bed unit costs around AED 179,999 per year. The starting price of a 4-BHK home is AED 230,000, and a 5-bedroom villa for rent in DAMAC Hills is AED 310,000. The Park Villas are excellent for searching for 3- to 6-bedroom villas, with prices starting at AED 180k.

The most popular community to rent apartments in Damac Hills is Carson - The Drive, which features three residential blocks with studio to 2-bed units. A fantastic option for renting an apartment in Dubai is Artesia. The residential building features apartments with rents ranging from AED 38k to AED 118k.

Buying a Property in Damac Hills

Buyers interested in DAMAC properties for sale can find a studio apartment in the community for about AED 450,000 and a 1-BHK flat for AED 499,000. You can buy a 2-bedroom and 3-bedroom flat for AED 899k and AED 1.75 million, respectively.

You can find a spacious 3-bedroom house for AED 2.19 million, whereas a 4-bedroom villa costs AED 4.82 million. Investors have to spend AED 2.95 million to get a five-bedroom unit. For investment purposes, The Park Villas, Golf Town, Brookfield, Carson-The Drive, and Trump Estate are the popular options in the area.

A house in The Park Villas can cost about AED 2.3 million, while in Golf Town, you can find a townhouse for AED 2.2 million. Brookfield also has an exquisite collection of townhouses and villas.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Damac Hills?

data.answer:
DAMAC Hills offers residents an active lifestyle, with plenty of recreational and sports opportunities readily available. You can find parks with jogging and cycling trails and sports venues. There are also numerous gyms, spas, and wellness centers for residents' convenience. Away from the hustle and bustle of city life, the self-sufficient community of DAMAC Hills ensures privacy and peaceful living.

Public Transportation in Damac Hills

The public transportation in DAMAC Hills includes a mix of buses and metro services. Here are the nearest metro stations and bus stops for residents.

NEAREST METRO STATION

  • Internet City - 15 minutes away

NEAREST BUS STOPS

  • Dubai Studio City, Operation Office 2, J03
  • DAMAC Hills, Brookfield, J04

Major Roads and Highways Near DAMAC Hills

DAMAC Hills is well-connected to key areas in Dubai via major roads and highways, including Hessa Street (D61) for direct access, Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street (D54) for connectivity to Emirates Road (E611), and Emirates Road (E611) itself, which offers routes to both Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport. Additionally, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) nearby connects DAMAC Hills to various parts of the city, including Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina.

Supermarkets in Damac Hills

DAMAC Hills has a community center with supermarkets like Carrefour and Viva, fulfilling the residents' grocery requirements. Carrefour is a popular international supermarket chain with outlets in major residential and commercial areas. You can buy groceries, household items, and other stuff from the store.

Viva is another supermarket chain in Dubai that offers a variety of products, including fresh produce, packaged goods, and household essentials.

Shopping Malls in Damac

There are various malls and retail centers near and inside DAMAC Hills. DAMAC Mall is a popular destination for a family day out in the heart of the community. The recreational center houses a supermarket, a medical center, and various stores. The mall has 40 retail and 10 F&B outlets and plenty of visitor parking space.

Mudon Community Center is a cozy retail destination located in the Mudon community. The shopping center is 5 minutes away from the DAMAC Hills area. It offers a variety of cafes and restaurants, along with retail stores featuring local and international brands.

12 minutes from the DAMAC Hills neighborhood, City Centre Me'aisem is a famous mall in Dubai Production City, home to high-street fashion brands, house and electronic stores, and Carrefour Hypermarket. The mall has various restaurants and cafes, like Paul Bakery and Restaurant, Leila, Gazebo, and Starbucks.

Schools And Nurseries in Damac Hills Dubai

DAMAC Hills residents enjoy a strategic location with a plethora of educational opportunities. The community houses the esteemed Jebel Ali School, offering high-quality education up to the 9th grade under the British Curriculum. Fairgreen International School is located in The Sustainable City, about 9 minutes away from the area. Built in 2018 by Esol Education, the school follows the IB curriculum.

Among the choices for preschool education in the community, Dibber, previously CreaKids Nursery, stands out as a favored option for parents of young children. Adhering to the Norwegian Curriculum, this nursery offers top-notch early childhood education for children from infancy to 6 years old. The nursery is 9 minutes away from the community.

Blossom Mudon Nursery is situated across the Al Salam Town Center in the vibrant Mudon Community of Dubai, 5 minutes away from DAMAC Hills. Specifically designed to focus on sustainability, this eco-friendly nursery guarantees a secure and stimulating atmosphere. The classrooms are strategically positioned, seamlessly connecting to a spacious, shaded play area for children to explore and enjoy.

Top-tier universities in Dubai, including Middlesex University and the University of Wollongong, are also close to the community.

Churches, Temples and Mosques in Damac

Inside the Silver Springs community of DAMAC Hills, there is a spacious mosque. Moreover, mosques situated in the surrounding area include the Mudon Mosque, Al Madinah Al Mustadama Masjid, and the Sustainable City Mosque.

The United Christian Church of Dubai in Jebel Ali Village is the closest church to the community. Emirates Baptist Church and St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church are other places of worship approximately 20 minutes from DAMAC Hills.

Clinics and Hospitals in Damac Hills

Within Artesia Tower B of the DAMAC Hills community lies the Saudi German Clinic, a renowned institution within the widely respected group of hospitals and clinics that has been delivering world-class medical facilities and treatments for years.

The other nearby healthcare institutions catering to the well-being of residents include the Medicare Medical Center in Motor City. It is a multi-specialty healthcare service located 10 minutes away from the community. Mediclinic Parkview Hospital is 12 minutes from DAMAC Hills and is known for its expert emergency service.

About 11 minutes away from the district, Apex Medical and Dental Clinic offers the best dental and medical services in the city. The clinic is located in Apex Atrium, Motor City. Another excellent choice for DAMAC Hills residents is Aster Clinic Dubailand, situated at a 17-minute distance from the location.

Location and Nearby Areas

DAMAC Hills is part of the larger Dubaliand community and offers easy access to various areas and notable landmarks. The site is home to the Trump International Golf Club and is close to the Dubai Miracle Garden. The key communities near DAMAC Hills are as follows:

  • Mudon
  • Remraam
  • Dubai Studio City
  • Arabian Ranches

Offering a mix of residential, commercial, and sports facilities, Mudon is home to the Dubai Autodrome. Developed by Dubai Properties Group, Remraam is designed to offer a mix of low and high-rise residential buildings, providing various accommodation options. Another district in Dubailand, Dubai Studio City, is a free zone dedicated to the media production industry. It is part of Tecom Group's Media Cluster in Dubai. The neighboring Arabian Ranches community is known for its lush landscaping and Arabian-themed architecture.

more_info.question: Things to Do in DAMAC Hills

data.answer:
DAMAC Hills offers a wealth of activities for residents and visitors alike. Enjoy a round of golf at the prestigious Trump International Golf Club, relax at the community parks and gardens, or take a leisurely stroll along the scenic walking trails. The area features numerous sports facilities, including tennis courts, a football field, and a skate park. For families, there are kids' play areas and outdoor movie nights. Additionally, the community center hosts various events and activities, ensuring there is always something fun and engaging to do in DAMAC Hills.

DAMAC Hills Community Events

DAMAC Hills fosters a vibrant and engaging community spirit through a variety of events and activities throughout the year. Residents can enjoy seasonal festivals, outdoor movie nights, farmers' markets, and fitness classes, all designed to bring neighbors together and enhance the community experience.

The community also hosts sports tournaments, family fun days, and themed celebrations, ensuring there is always something exciting happening for all age groups. These events not only provide entertainment and recreation but also help build strong connections among residents, creating a lively and cohesive community atmosphere.

DAMAC Hills Attraction

DAMAC Hills offers diverse activities to cater to the different interests and preferences of the residents. They can enjoy golf, good food, and numerous retail options on Akoya Drive, try ice skating, or catch a movie in this fun-packed neighborhood. Residents can connect with other residents in the community by attending events and activities organized regularly.

These include everything from fitness classes and social gatherings to seasonal celebrations and festivals. Also, you can explore various parks and community spaces in DAMAC Hills. Whether you're into sports, outdoor activities, or fine dining, DAMAC Hills provides a well-rounded living experience with various things to do.

Damac Hills Restaurants & Bars

DAMAC Hills boasts numerous family-friendly dining options, providing residents with various excellent gastronomic choices. The Trump Clubhouse offers an exclusive fine dining experience, complementing the diverse culinary scene in the area.

Nestled within the Trump International Golf Club in Damac Hills, Prato Italian Restaurant offers guests an authentic culinary experience. The eatery is known for its warm hospitality and inviting atmosphere. The menu pays homage to Italian traditions, where robust flavors are elevated through time-honored ember-cooking techniques.

FireLake Grill House Restaurant & Bar is a restaurant that falls under the FireLake brand and is known for its contemporary American cuisine. The cuisine at FireLake Grill House typically features a variety of grilled meats, seafood, and other dishes cooked with open-flame grilling techniques. It is located in the Radisson Hotel Dubai Damac Hills.

Charlie Khan's is a British Doner Kebab Restaurant located inside the neighborhood. They are known for serving authentic UK-style donner kebabs, pizzas, and burgers. The other restaurants in the DAMAC Hills community are McDonald’s, Maria Bonita Taco Shop, Tuk Tuk Thai Cuisine Restaurant, and Subway.

The Irish Village in Dubai Studio City is a popular bar near the community. It is considered the perfect destination for an authentic Irish pub experience. There are also various other pubs nearby. These include 31 Sports Bar, Nelle Gwynne English Pub, and Dubai Polo Bar.

Beaches Near Damac Hills

DAMAC Hills is a little far from some of Dubai's renowned beaches. Jumeirah Public Beach and Al Sufouh Beach, notable coastal destinations, are approximately a 21-minute drive away. Another popular choice, Kite Beach, known for its lively ambiance and diverse food trucks, is about 24 minutes from the community.

Hotels in Damac Hills

Akoya Drive, the vibrant recreational hub, showcases a variety of hotels, with some currently undergoing construction and others already in operation. For extended stays, individuals can opt for a serviced apartment within one of the distinguished projects, like Golf Terrace, Artesia, Carson, and the Golf Veduta.

Radisson Dubai DAMAC Hills is a 5-star hotel that offers luxury suites with scenic views of the golf course. Developed in collaboration with The Radisson Hotel Group, this project delivers the promised amenities synonymous with the signature brand. Nestled within the esteemed DAMAC Hills development in Dubai, the Radisson Dubai DAMAC boasts 481 keys. It ranks among the more expansive hotels in the vicinity, ensuring a truly indulgent experience for its guests.

DAMAC Hills 2 Hotel, a property managed by Edge by Rotana, is a contemporary and sophisticated three-star establishment within Dubai's dynamic DAMAC Hills 2 community. Guests at DAMAC Hills 2 Hotel, Edge by Rotana, can anticipate both convenience and comfort in proximity to renowned attractions such as the Malibu Beach wave pool, sports fields, outdoor cinema, paintball arcade, butterfly garden, and more.

Guests can select from the 295 stylishly appointed rooms and suites, each featuring cutting-edge in-room technology, balconies, and functional work desks. Indulge in the conveniences of an all-day dining restaurant and bar, a fully equipped gym, and two outdoor temperature-controlled swimming pools.

Studio One Hotel is a boutique hotel designed with a contemporary and creative theme, catering to the artistic and media-centric environment of Dubai Studio City. It is a 4-star hotel with 141 bedrooms, 19 extended-stay studios and apartments, and rooms for people of determination. It is just 7 minutes away from the district.

Attractions and Landmarks in Damac Hills

DAMAC Hills offers residents and visitors a range of attractions and amenities.  The Trump International Golf Club provides golf enthusiasts with a scenic and challenging experience. Take a stroll or bike ride through the expansive Akoya Park. With tranquil villas, walkways, and small waterways, it's a serene environment for outdoor activities or simply relaxing amidst nature.

Residents can also dine and shop on Akoya Drive. Discover the lively ambiance of Akoya Drive, which offers upscale dining establishments, retail stores, and family-friendly entertainment options. This boulevard is inspired by iconic locations like Rodeo Drive and the Champs Elysees, offering a sophisticated and lively ambiance.

Enjoy unique recreational activities on Akoya Drive, such as ice skating and catching a movie at the cinema. Moreover, you can explore the Trump Clubhouse at the golf club, which offers more than just golf. With restaurants, swimming pools, gymnasiums, and a health club, it's a hub for relaxation and socializing.

Residents can also attend the fantastic events at the Amphitheatre. The venue hosts the city's best cultural and entertainment events throughout the year. Damac Hills Park offers a serene haven for leisurely escapes. Whether you want to go for a peaceful stroll, engage in recreational activities, or simply find a tranquil spot to unwind, this enchanting park is the place to be.

Damac Hills Pet Farm emerges as another delightful destination, particularly for children. Nestled in the scenic embrace of the Damac Hills, this charming farm serves as an educational hub where youngsters can discover various farm animals. The farm is the home of different breeds of rabbits, deer, sheep, tortoises, peacocks, and goats.

As there are no public transportation options inside the community, those considering renting or purchasing a villa or apartment should ideally have a personal vehicle for commuting. Fortunately, ample parking is available for residents in DAMAC Hills.

What is the DAMAC Hills location?

It is located in Dubailand, along the Al Qudra Road (D63) and Hessa Street (D61).

What was the previous name of DAMAC Hills?

The luxury residential community in Dubailand was previously known as Akoya. 

What types of properties are available in DAMAC Hills?

DAMAC Hills offers a variety of properties, including apartments, townhouses, villas, and luxury villas, managed in collaboration with renowned brands like Fendi, the Trump Organization, and Paramount Hotels & Resorts.

Who owns DAMAC Hills?

Hussain Sajwani, the visionary Emirati entrepreneur and creator of DAMAC Properties, a renowned global property development firm, played a pivotal role in shaping the Middle East's real estate landscape. He launched the project at DAMAC Hills in 2013.

Why choose DAMAC Hills?

The DAMAC Hills community presents numerous advantages, establishing itself as an integrated residential destination in Dubai. It encompasses all essential facilities and services, from nearby stores, entertainment options, and schools to comprehensive health facilities.

Can I get real estate financing for residential units in DAMAC Hills?

DAMAC Properties collaborates with various financial institutions in the UAE to offer mortgage and real estate financing services spanning up to 25 years. For more information, you can contact one of our representatives.

What are the golf courses in DAMAC Hills?

The area is home to the Trump International Golf Club. Renowned golf course architect Gil Hanse designed this 18-hole, par 71 championship course. The club features luxurious facilities, including a modern clubhouse, fine dining restaurants, a pro shop, and state-of-the-art practice areas.

How far are Dubai airports from the DAMAC Hills community?

Dubai International Airport is approximately 35 kilometers away from DAMAC Hills, taking around 30-35 minutes by car. Al Maktoum International Airport is closer, at roughly 25 kilometers, with a driving time of about 20-25 minutes.

How can I inquire about prices, available units, and offers in DAMAC Hills?

To inquire about prices, available units, and offers in DAMAC Hills, you can visit the DAMAC Properties official website, contact their sales office directly, or visit the DAMAC Hills sales center. You can also reach out to local real estate agents who specialize in DAMAC Hills properties.

What are the most prominent entertainment destinations near the DAMAC Hills community?

Prominent entertainment destinations near DAMAC Hills include the Dubai Autodrome, offering thrilling motorsport experiences, and Global Village, which provides a multicultural festival park with shopping, dining, and entertainment. Additionally, the Mall of the Emirates, featuring Ski Dubai, is just a short drive away, offering a wide range of shopping, dining, and indoor skiing experiences.

data.content:
Are you looking for a tranquil residence with top facilities and a wealth of outdoor attractions? DAMAC Hills is the best choice for those seeking an active, nature-friendly environment. Discover a distinctive lifestyle in Dubai's most prestigious golf community and find your dream home amidst luxury and sophistication.

Spread over 42 million square feet of land with Trump Golf Dubai as its centerpiece, DAMAC Hills is one of the most popular golf communities in Dubai. It boasts luxurious modern villas, townhouses, and apartments amid lush green pathways in collaboration with renowned brands.

Besides the golf course, DAMAC Hills features a myriad of other amenities, including stable farms, a dog park, jogging tracks, a fitness center, and a fishing lake. Located near Remraam and Motor City, the district offers easy access to the rest of the city via Al Qudra Road (D63) and Hessa Street (D61).

nodes.title: Damac District
nodes.about:
DAMAC District is a dynamic mixed-use development located in the heart of DAMAC Hills. Developed by DAMAC Properties, the project brings together residential and commercial excellence across three striking towers. Two towers are residential and one is commercial, housing a total of 1,008 units. Offering stylish 1 and 2 bedroom apartments along with premium office spaces, DAMAC District is designed to blend modern living with professional opportunities.

This development combines elegant design, curated amenities, and an ideal location. With facilities such as a swimming pool, fitness centre, clubhouse, and landscaped gardens, the community creates an environment where leisure, wellness, and productivity meet seamlessly. DAMAC District residences are tailored for those who value connectivity, lifestyle, and investment potential.

nodes.title: Artesia
nodes.about:
Artesia is a residential development in DAMAC Hills consisting of a hotel and three premium towers. The residential units include studios, 1-3 bedroom apartments. Developed by DAMAC Properties, the project features an ultra-modern architectural design with panoramic views of the neighbourhood.

The residences are fully equipped and decorated by renowned designers using high quality materials. The apartments are equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay, including furniture, appliances and kitchenware. The building offers all necessary features such as water supply, ventilation, air conditioning, fire safety equipment, video surveillance and lifts.

The Artesia complex offers a wide range of amenities including: swimming pool, shopping outlets, pharmacies, restaurants, parking, spa, fitness and wellness services, entertainment for children and adults, public areas.

The community has plenty of green spaces and parks around the complex, so residents can enjoy nature. Artesia offers beautifully landscaped grounds with flowering gardens, natural landmarks, walking and cycling paths.

There are kindergartens, schools and colleges, hospitals and clinics, shopping centres, beaches, golf clubs and polo clubs nearby.

The nearby motorways provide quick and easy access to other parts of Dubai, and the community is located close to other developed areas such as Remraham and Mudon.

nodes.title: Cavalli Estates Villas
nodes.about:
Cavalli Estates Villas at DAMAC Hills presents an elite collection of 6- and 7-bedroom ultra-luxury villas, crafted in collaboration with the world-renowned Italian fashion brand Roberto Cavalli. From marble-clad finishes and gold accents to bespoke interior details, every corner of these villas radiates glamour, style, and sophistication.

Each residence is thoughtfully designed to reflect the legacy of Cavalli—featuring functional yet luxurious layouts with spacious living areas flooded with natural light. Floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows frame captivating views of the lush Trump International Golf Club. The outdoor space is equally impressive, featuring a private swimming pool, jacuzzi, yoga zone, and dedicated barbecue and seating areas for elegant alfresco entertaining.

Nestled within the prestigious DAMAC Hills community, Cavalli Estates by DAMAC Properties offers residents unrivaled convenience with proximity to premium shopping centers, gourmet restaurants, reputable schools, and everyday essentials. Cavalli Estates Villas is the ultimate choice for those who seek statement-making design, spacious living, and an immersive lifestyle defined by luxury.

nodes.title: BelAir at The Trump Estates
nodes.about:
BelAir at The Trump Estates - a limited exclusive collection of villas with magnificent facades created in collaboration with the world's finest architects, impeccable interiors designed specifically for each market and recognised world-class service. Each residence is an elegant and contemporary living space that perfectly blends natural surroundings, an abundance of light and space.

The development is located within the large community of Damac Hills, adjacent to the renowned Trump International Dubai Golf Club. There are 4,000,000 sq ft of parkland offering a variety of themed recreational and sporting areas including tranquil gardens and lakes, skate park, stables, football pitch and tennis courts. The Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club is 10 minutes away and Dubai Autodrome, Miracle Garden, Global Village and IMG World are 15 minutes away.

Within BelAir at The Trump Estates, residents can also find a host of recreational amenities. Among them:

  • Swimming pool
  • Barbecue area
  • Children's playground
  • Gym
  • Jacuzzi

nodes.title: Jasmine
nodes.about:
Jasmine is a luxury residential development in DAMAC Hills consisting of two buildings Jasmine A and Jasmine B, as well as townhouses. Apartments range from studios to 3-bedroom residences, townhouses are mostly 3-4 bedrooms. The interior finishes are in neutral colours and the apartments are furnished and equipped with appliances. All units have panoramic glazing and balconies that offer beautiful views of the local natural attractions and golf course.

Inside the residences and on the territory of the complex there is everything necessary for a comfortable life: lifts, ventilation, air conditioning, water supply, video surveillance, swimming pool, SPA - centres, fitness rooms, car parks, catering establishments, retail outlets, pharmacies and other elements of the internal infrastructure.

Jasmine residential complex is surrounded by picturesque green landscapes, among gardens and parks belonging to the Akoya Oxygen themed area. The community popularises a quiet, measured life in unity with nature.

CreaKids daycare centre is located close to the complex. Jebel Ali School is a 7-minute walk away and South View School is 9 minutes by car. The nearest medical centre, Mediclinic Parkview Hospital, is a 15-minute drive away. Convenient road links allow for easy access by own or public transport. The nearest bus stop Mudon Al Salam Town Centre is an 8 minute walk away, Umm Al Sheif Metro Station is 15 minutes away and the International Airport is 30 minutes by car.

nodes.title: Golf Gate 2
nodes.about:
Golf Gate 2 - a luxury residential development created by DAMAC Properties and part of the prestigious Damac Hills community.

Located in a gated community, Golf Gate 2 offers residents a tranquil and upscale living experience. Residences are designed to maximize comfort and convenience, embodying contemporary architectural styles and upscale finishes.

One of the main attractions of Golf Gate 2 is its proximity to Trump International Golf Club Dubai, which is located within Damac Hills. This championship golf course, designed by renowned golfer Tiger Woods, offers residents access to world-class golf courses and breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape.

The complex also offers a variety of recreational options including parks, sports facilities, fitness centers, swimming pools and landscaped gardens. A large amount of green space is planned for the complex, creating a tranquil atmosphere for residents to enjoy.

In addition, residents of Golf Gate 2 have easy access to shopping centers, restaurants, schools and other necessary facilities in the nearby areas. The complex is well connected to major highways, providing easy access to the rest of Dubai. Golf Gate 2 is an ideal option for those seeking a luxurious lifestyle in a tranquil and well-organized community, one of the main values of which is the opportunity to play golf.
